description: Query or update Zola wedding-planning data (vendors, budget, guests, seating, events/RSVPs, registry, gift tracker, inquiries, wedding website) straight from a shell with curl against mobile-api.zola.com, instead of running the zola-mcp server. Use when you want Zola data without the MCP, in a script, or on a machine where the MCP isn't installed. Triggers on "check Zola", "Zola vendors/budget/guests/RSVP/seating/registry", or any Zola wedding data request that should hit the API directly.
